briefdescription.para: path - The path entries, path[0] is the root node, path.back() is a leaf.
valid - Return true if path is at a valid node, not at end().
height - Return the height of the tree corresponding to this path.

detaileddescription.para: This matches map->height in a full path.

briefdescription.para: subtree - Get the subtree referenced from Level.

detaileddescription.para:
When the path is consistent, node(Level + 1) == subtree(Level).
Level
0..height-1. The leaves have no subtrees.

briefdescription.para: reset - Reset cached information about node(Level) from subtree(Level -1).

parameterdescription.para: 1..height. The node to update after parent node changed.
Node to add, should be subtree(path.size()-1).

briefdescription.para: pop - Remove the last path entry.
setSize - Set the size of a node both in the path and in the tree.

parameterdescription.para: 0..height. Note that setting the root size won't change map->rootSize.

briefdescription.para: setRoot - Clear the path and set a new root node.
replaceRoot - Replace the current root node with two new entries after the tree height has increased.

parameterdescription.para: Number of entries in the new root.
Offsets into the root and first branch nodes.

briefdescription.para: getLeftSibling - Get the left sibling node at Level, or a null NodeRef.
moveLeft - Move path to the left sibling at Level.

detaileddescription.para:
Leave nodes below Level unaltered.
Level
Move node(Level).

briefdescription.para: fillLeft - Grow path to Height by taking leftmost branches.
getLeftSibling - Get the left sibling node at Level, or a null NodeRef.
moveRight - Move path to the left sibling at Level.

detaileddescription.para:
Leave nodes below Level unaltered.
Level
Move node(Level).

briefdescription.para: atBegin - Return true if path is at begin().
atLastEntry - Return true if the path is at the last entry of the node at Level.
legalizeForInsert - Prepare the path for an insertion at Level.

detaileddescription.para:
When the path is at end(), node(Level) may not be a legal node. legalizeForInsert ensures that node(Level) is real by moving back to the last node at Level, and setting offset(Level) to size(Level) if required.
Level
The level where an insertion is about to take place.
